dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
purpose: Wing and part introductions for the entrance pages, written to be read or heard before a visitor chooses a room. Room order follows curation/exhibitions/structure/.

wings.title: Faces
introduction: One hundred and thirty-four faces, drawn between October 2021 and July 2022. They begin with a white box head on green and end with a collection piece that spells the artist's name across the square. Every one is a head, and almost every one has teeth.

The six rooms are hung by what the faces are made of. Heads built from boxes. Faces found in a tangle of scribble. Faces with weight and light. Skulls in the dark. Sparer faces in line on flat color. And box heads with their eyes crossed out, which end the wing with the collection piece.
The parts recur from room to room: the ringed eye, the spiral, the X, the grid of block teeth. What changes is how much of the square they are allowed to fill.

wings.title: New Nifty on the Block
introduction: Three hundred and three works in ten months, from December 8, 2021 to October 15, 2022. It is the largest collection here, and it changes as it goes, so the wing is in three dated parts, each with its own rooms.

The first part is figures and creatures: crowds of line, black silhouettes on bright color, skeletons, painted places, and the beams of May. The second is the mask summer, ten weeks of square, round and scribbled heads. The third is the August cats, a turn to portraits, and the crowned masks that end on the three works of October 15.
Every room is hung in the order the works were drawn. Read across the parts and the whole year is there: the line, then the mask, then the face.

parts.title: Figures and Creatures
introduction: The first six months. Whole figures and creatures, before the masks: crowds drawn as line, flat black animals ringed with wavy marks, bony skeletons dancing on color, soft painted places, and in May a run of heads whose eyes give off light.
Six rooms. Start with the black silhouettes if you want the clearest formula, or with the line figures if you want to see the first drawing in the collection.

parts.title: Masks
introduction: Ten weeks in which nearly every drawing was a mask. Heads built as boxes inside boxes, heads drawn as rings and profiles, heads buried in scribble, and one room of what else was drawn in between: figures, crowds, a dog, a tree.
Four rooms. The parts of the mask are a kit, and each room is a different way of arranging it.

parts.title: Cats and Portraits
introduction: The last eight weeks. Two weeks of black cats in striped rooms, then flat creatures in one color each; heads that look like people, in hats, with worried eyes; and the last crowned masks, ending on the three works made on October 15, 2022, the last of them the collection piece.
Three rooms. The wing ends in Crowns and Last Masks, on #0000.

wings.title: Rawblocks
introduction: Sixty-six works, nearly all from October 30, 2022 to March 15, 2023, with two masks from the May before. Portraits painted fast, patterned masks and flat black figures, heads in a few lines and heads in a storm of them, and a collection piece that crowds the whole series into one square.
Three rooms, and then a coda: the two landscapes painted in the hours after the collection piece, the only works in the series with no head in them. They close the wing.
wings.codaNote: Coda: Two Landscapes holds two works and is named as a coda, not a room.

wings.title: Abstract
introduction: Fifty-two works with no faces and no dates. The Abstract series comes from a different platform and carries no record of when each work was made, so the rooms follow the title numbers, which run from bands and washes toward thrown and swirled marks.
Two rooms. The first is bars, stripes, grids and washes, marks laid side by side until they make a surface. The second is splashes, scribbles and swirls, and it ends on the collection piece.

wings.title: Other nnxyz
introduction: Forty-five works outside the named series, from the first day on Nifty Ink in October 2021 to December 2024. Pieces made for occasions, milestones and summers; a few full figures and scenes; and the numbered masks of 2023 and 2024, denser and heavier than the earlier ones.
Two rooms. The first holds the occasions and figures, with one related item from Scrimshaw shown at its end. The second holds the masks.

wings.title: Scrimshaw
introduction: Twenty-five heads by Scrimshaw, a different artist who drew on Nifty Ink at the same time. They are the earliest works in the collection, most of them from a single evening in February 2021, and they are built from loose, looping colored line on bright grounds.
One room. The related greeting GM hangs in Occasions and Figures in the Other nnxyz wing.
wings.attribution: Works by Scrimshaw (scrimshaw.eth); attribution is retained on every page.
